perplexity.description:
Wait Til I Get Over" is the debut solo studio album by American musician Durand Jones, released on May 5, 2023, through Dead Oceans. The album marks a stylistic shift from his work with Durand Jones & The Indications, embracing a rawer, gospel-soul sound that deeply explores the Southern Black experience and pays homage to his hometown of Hillaryville, Louisiana. Its musical style blends elements of funk, soul, and gospel, characterized by gritty vocals and heartfelt storytelling that convey both personal and communal themes.

Positioned after three albums with his band, this solo effort stands out in Jones's discography as a more intimate and thematically focused project. Critics acclaimed the album for its emotional depth and authenticity; for example, NME awarded it five stars, highlighting its "gritty but glorious" nature and the triumph it represents for Jones as a solo artist. Commercially, "Wait Til I Get Over" achieved notable success by charting in the top 40 in Scotland and reaching respectable positions on UK independent and download charts, reflecting both critical and audience appreciation.
